diapositivas.codigoAnimacion:
<a-entity id="escena_lluvia" position="0 0 0" scale="0.25 0.25 0.25">

    <!-- NUBE ANIMADA -->
    <a-entity id="nube" position="-0.2 1.5 0" animation="property: position; to: 0.2 1.5 0; dir: alternate; dur: 3000; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        
        <!-- Cuerpo de la nube -->
        <a-sphere position="0 0 0" radius="0.5" color="#94a3b8"></a-sphere>
        <a-sphere position="0.4 -0.1 0.1" radius="0.4" color="#cbd5e1"></a-sphere>
        <a-sphere position="-0.4 -0.1 0.1" radius="0.4" color="#cbd5e1"></a-sphere>
        <a-sphere position="0.2 0.2 0" radius="0.35" color="#e2e8f0"></a-sphere>
        <a-sphere position="-0.2 0.2 0" radius="0.35" color="#e2e8f0"></a-sphere>
        
        <!-- LLUVIA (Gotas programadas) -->
        <a-cylinder position="-0.3 -0.5 0" radius="0.015" height="0.2" color="#3b82f6" opacity="0.6" animation="property: position; to: -0.3 -2.5 0; dur: 400; loop: true; easing: linear; delay: 0"></a-cylinder>
        <a-cylinder position="0.1 -0.4 0.1" radius="0.015" height="0.2" color="#3b82f6" opacity="0.6" animation="property: position; to: 0.1 -2.5 0.1; dur: 450; loop: true; easing: linear; delay: 100"></a-cylinder>
        <a-cylinder position="-0.1 -0.6 -0.1" radius="0.015" height="0.2" color="#3b82f6" opacity="0.6" animation="property: position; to: -0.1 -2.5 -0.1; dur: 380; loop: true; easing: linear; delay: 200"></a-cylinder>
        <a-cylinder position="0.3 -0.5 -0.1" radius="0.015" height="0.2" color="#3b82f6" opacity="0.6" animation="property: position; to: 0.3 -2.5 -0.1; dur: 420; loop: true; easing: linear; delay: 50"></a-cylinder>
        <a-cylinder position="0 -0.4 0.2" radius="0.015" height="0.2" color="#3b82f6" opacity="0.6" animation="property: position; to: 0 -2.5 0.2; dur: 410; loop: true; easing: linear; delay: 150"></a-cylinder>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- EL CARTEL FLOTANTE -->
    <a-entity position="0 0 0.5" animation="property: position; to: 0 0.1 0.5; dir: alternate; dur: 2000; loop: true">
        <!-- Fondo oscuro del letrero -->
        <a-plane width="5.5" height="2" color="#0f172a"></a-plane>
        <!-- Borde color azul eléctrico del cartel -->
        <a-plane width="5.7" height="2.2" color="#3b82f6" position="0 0 -0.01"></a-plane>
        
        <!-- Texto del cartel -->
        <a-text 
            value="¡Bienvenidos a la clase de\nFundamentos de la\nMetodologia de la Investigacion!" 
            color="#ffffff" 
            align="center" 
            width="5"
            line-height="60"
            position="0 0 0.05">
        </a-text>
    </a-entity>

</a-entity>
